title: Mainframe Developer
summary: Mainframe developers write and maintain COBOL programs on IBM mainframes (large central computers) that run banking, cards and insurance systems. Most work in IT services or bank technology centres, with an onshore client team and a batch support rota.
dailyDuties: Change COBOL programs for new business rules
Write and fix JCL for batch jobs
Write DB2 SQL to read and check data
Fix abends in the nightly batch cycle
Promote code through Endevor or ChangeMan
Update the onshore team on ticket status

skills.expectation: Write and change COBOL batch and online programs
Write and fix JCL for batch jobs
Write DB2 SQL in programs and for data checks
Build and fix CICS online transactions
Use TSO/ISPF, Endevor or ChangeMan, and File-AID or Xpediter
Monitor and rerun batch cycles in Control-M or CA-7
Fix abends and production issues within the agreed time
Know banking, cards or insurance processes
Work in sprints with an onshore team
Help move mainframe logic to Java services
Give clear status updates to onshore clients
